comments.comment: readHeader parses a note's YAML header by splitting each line at its first colon, though the repository already depends on yaml, whose parse reads that format.
comments.failureScenario: A note opens with a header whose title line is `title: "Plans: 2027"` and whose tags line is `tags: [work, home]`. readHeader returns the title with its quotation marks kept, `"Plans: 2027"`, and tags as the text `[work, home]`. yaml's parse, which loadConfig already calls, returns the title Plans: 2027 and a list of two tags.
